title: MV I want to make tiles in a smaller size- How do I do that?

posts.author: thisnameisdead
posts.body: I want to make a game that has a similar pixel style as the mother games, or undertale, and was thinking of designing the tiles in 16x16 format. I don't know if I can directly port tiles that small directly into rpg maker itself, so I was wondering if anyone knew how to do that? I could probably scale up tiles to the 48x48 size in aseprite but I'm worried that would cause issues in terms of workflow/be very time consuming.

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body:
You could try using Shaz's Change Tile Size plugin:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/change-tile-size.46748/
Alternatively, if you want to scale up your tiles in Aseprite, you can draw or paste your 16x16 pixel tiles in an MV tilesheet format (e.g., for a B tilesheet, it'd be 16x16 tiles wide). Then go to File > Export > Export as, and under Resize, choose 300%. It'll automatically scale up using the nearest neighbor method, and IIRC, Aseprite remembers the setting each time you export, so you just have to set it once for each file.
If you were using MZ, you can actually choose your tile size in the Database (16, 24, 32 or 48 pixels).
